Outcome PR B, not a separate PR per bead. Baseline a0c8796e21412a4e4334d4bd5ee928d339638c78 includes 941c8536 coverage and conversation-less reuse/missing-root fixes. Revalidate any newer tip. Approved isolated branch feature/issue-768-history-b-execution stacks on feature/issue-768-history-a-integration. No former test-handoff wait remains. Preserve concurrent work; base fixes land in PR A and propagate into B.
Read AGENTS.md, docs/agent-tools.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, applicable Agent harness/Engine guides and docs/services/message-lifecycle.md. Regressions FIRST; real internal routing, permissions, persistence and Jido, mocking external provider/LLM edges only. Follow issue-level validation and final review/coverage gates. B human UX approval (.32) precedes new browser E2E. Planning only; no implementation, completion or commit/push authorization.

## Work package
workspace, baseline and tracking

- Read applicable Agent harness checks, Engine guide, Action reuse, testing and
  workflow policies, plus `docs/services/message-lifecycle.md`. Verify existing
  moduledocs and callers before extending them. Serena returned empty overviews
  for the inspected Engine modules; bounded source reads supplied this assessment.
- Verify effective Repo host/port/database before setup or migrations. The latest
  dev configuration adds DB_PORT/DB_NAME handling but contains two database
  entries; do not assume an environment override provides worktree isolation.
- Create/reuse child issues under `.30` for B1–B4, wire dependencies, and verify the
  ready set. Keep full-outcome approval/E2E issues separate from this first leg.
- Record B3's concrete receipt/state-transition representation and canonical usage
  source as a bounded contract-design subtask. Resolve both against the existing
  schema, constraints and consumers before B1–B3 production changes; its output is
  the field/result contract and failing tests, not a new execution subsystem.
  The acceptance invariants in B3 are fixed; physical storage must honor them.
- Start from `a0c8796e`, which already contains the former test handoff. Review the
  now-committed Agent API/executor, delivery, transcript and projection regressions
  before editing overlapping tests. Recheck for any newer user/session work at
  Build startup and preserve it; no additional handoff is currently required.
- Run targeted baseline regressions for source identity/storage, replay/merge,
  neutral ingress/delivery and the existing real Mattermost history flow in the
  isolated worktree. Reuse existing tests; do not recreate remediation tests.
- Include the newly added ownership, audience/projection, query-budget, accounting
  and Factory timeout tests listed in B4, plus conversation-less reuse and missing-
  root regressions. Reconcile the current CI run rather than carrying forward the
  previous head's failed or passing status as current acceptance evidence.
- Author the primary full-path scenario specified in B4 now and confirm its
  missing-behavior failures before B1–B3 production changes. Keep it as the
  acceptance test throughout implementation; B4 completes the matrix and validates
  the integrated result rather than postponing that first regression.
- Action reuse: setup/tracking is not an executable domain operation. Record
  baseline results in Beadwork, not as new repository policy documentation.

## Shared preservation contracts

The original remediation proposal was superseded during implementation. Consume
the final contracts, not its intermediate HistoryEvidence/HistoryProvider design.

| Area | Current contract and consequence for B |
| --- | --- |
| Normalized ingress | `Incoming.RoutingContext.conversation_type` is `:one_to_one`, `:room`, `:recipient_addressed`, or nil. Channels owns provider parsing, exact source scope, timestamps and message-local audience. Do not restore `history_kind` or `title_style` transport fields. |
| Policy/capture | `Engine.History.CommunicationPolicy.kind/1` maps neutral facts to Direct/Shared/Replicated; Engine derives titles and capture policy. Reuse normal ingress and `IncomingMessageRouter`; do not restore caller-controlled `capture_history` flags or provider branches in Agent/Engine. |
| Source identity | `SourceIdentity.valid_scope?/1` accepts nil or an opaque 1–255-byte binary. Preserve JSON account-key encoding and canonical identity. Apply `20261003000000_widen_message_source_account_key.exs`; it widens storage to text without rewriting data, and refuses unsafe rollback narrowing. |
| Replay/merge | Conflicting placement/audience fails rather than adopting old replicas. Preserve canonical UUIDs, positions, separate replica resources and post-merge replay behavior. Redelivery never recreates revoked grants. |
| Conversation-less canonical rows | They remain valid canonical content, but `existing_message_id` reuse as an admitted input or confirmed execution response requires the existing conversation-backed proof. A nil conversation returns `:source_conflict` with no row/placement/cursor mutation; do not treat arbitrary canonical IDs as execution capabilities. |
| Delivery | Channels `DeliveryConfirmation.record/3` dispatches neutral receipt/outgoing evidence via Engine `:record_delivery_confirmation`. `Engine.History.Delivery` interprets it and delegates canonical confirmation to `HistoryIngress`. A successful send with unavailable association stays a successful send; no resend through history recovery. |
| Configuration | The schema is `Zaq.Engine.ChannelConfig`, retaining its existing table and IDs. Email persistence/archive policy are Engine-owned; transport receives supplied runtime maps. B fixtures and aliases must follow the moved schema. |
| Provider queries/BO | Room capability/member/message queries are consumer-neutral. Preserve batched BO projections, detail-only provider root fallback, confidential administration and runtime-only archive retry. |
| Missing thread roots | A child transcript and its authorized replies remain usable when no local root exists. Root projection is nullable; mixed pages preserve order, titles and existing root ratings, and rating lookup filters nil/duplicate IDs. BO detail may use its existing authorized provider fallback; Agent hydration must not borrow that admin privilege or invent a root. |
| Ownership APIs | `Conversations.list_owned_transcripts/2`, `list_person_executions/2`, `change_transcript_owner/2`, `update_transcript_owner/2`, `change_execution_owner/2`, `update_execution_owner/2` replace merge-specific context helpers. Reads use literal owners and stable ID order. `lock: true` requires an existing transaction; `allow_missing_table: true` is historical-migration compatibility only, never a live-history error fallback. These are internal storage APIs, not authorization grants. |
| Capture/admission performance | Reuse the connector and canonical message within one capture's recipient fan-out; still validate each target and lock association writes. Admission reuses its validated source result under the existing source lock. Do not hoist these values into cross-request caches or bypass fresh permission checks. |
| Confirmation input | `TranscriptHistory.prepare_execution_response/3` now receives the already-locked response `%Message{}` as its second argument, not an answer ID to reload. Only the enclosing HistoryIngress confirmation transaction supplies that row; preserve pair/source checks and durable recovery. |
| Transport selection | Provider-only delivery/upsert resolves the connector once and calls `fetch_connection_details_for_config/1` on that exact row. Preserve explicit-connector and ambiguity behavior when changing request/status/delivery paths. |
| Accounting | Pending usage jobs coalesce by conversation/model/date only in available/scheduled/retryable states. Executing jobs must allow a later pass. Aggregation locks conversation metadata and sums the explicit message day using a half-open UTC interval; retries replace totals rather than incrementing twice. |
| Tool budgets | SearchKnowledgeBase declares 120,000 ms; effective Jido worker budget is the maximum declared by enabled tools with the ordinary 15,000-ms floor. Preserve live add/remove behavior and the distinction between tool execution, stream inactivity, request wait and delivery deadlines. |

Admission/finalization remain the existing Engine operations. Preserve the current
binding's `conversation_id`, `user_message_id` and opaque `finalization_token` while
adding validated execution references as necessary; update every consumer of any
intentional extension. A message ID or caller-supplied binding is not authority.


## Failing acceptance scenario to author before production changes
complete full-path acceptance and regression preservation

Extend `test/zaq/channels/mattermost_shared_history_integration_test.exs` and its
existing support fixtures (or a focused companion) with a real configured Jido
agent and registered tool. Use the remediated provider registration, neutral facts
and Engine configuration schema. Keep NodeRouter, permission checks, Engine,
Factory, Jido and tool implementation real; fake only provider HTTP and LLM APIs.

The primary scenario must:

1. Create two People, a connector, routing rule and real grants.
2. Establish passive/shared/thread history through real provider ingress; create
   distinguishable forbidden history and another execution's private data.
3. Send an explicit request through the actual chat adapter and normal route.
4. Inspect the actual LLM request: authorized attributed history present, root and
   current input once when the root exists, forbidden/private data absent; the
   missing-root companion includes the current input once and preserves replies.
5. Return a tool call, execute a real registered tool, inspect the correctly paired
   tool result in the next LLM request, then return the final answer.
6. Assert Person/runtime/request ownership, private persistence, one public-answer
   UUID, exact connector/channel/thread delivery and confirmed canonical placement.
7. Replay the input and verify no second execution, answer, placement or delivery.

Companion scenarios cover B1–B3 races/failures and Direct/Replicated authorization,
including remediated long scopes, conflicting replay, merged replica isolation,
conversation-less execution reuse rejection and missing-root hydration. For the
last case, inspect the actual LLM request and ensure no fabricated root or
unauthorized provider/admin fetch occurs; BO rendering tests alone are insufficient.
Property tests cover broad isolation/idempotency/state-transition invariants, not
implementation mirroring. Preserve unique coverage while removing obsolete paths.

Preservation matrix for the October 7 base (run affected suites, extend only for
new behavior):

- `test/zaq/accounts/person_merge_test.exs`: narrow ownership APIs, ordered
  transaction locks, validation/rollback and migration-only missing-table handling.
- `test/zaq/engine/messages/incoming/audience_test.exs` and
  `test/zaq/engine/channel_history_admin_test.exs`: complete audience evidence,
  participant tie ordering, merged-Person deduplication and assistant exclusion.
- `test/zaq/engine/conversations/transcript_history_test.exs`: five recipient
  placements share one canonical message insert and one connector lookup; recipient
  reordering/duplicates preserve message identity and transcript positions;
  conversation-less user/assistant reuse rejects atomically without modifying
  the canonical message or transcript position.
- `test/zaq/engine/channel_history_projection_test.exs` and
  `test/zaq_web/live/bo/communication/channel_history_live_test.exs`: missing-root
  child visibility/readability and mixed-page order/rating preservation, including
  the authorized detail provider-404 case. Preserve batched root/rating lookup.
- `test/zaq/engine/history_ingress_test.exs`: scoped admission has one connector
  lookup; confirmation has two Message SELECTs, reuses the locked answer and keeps
  replay identity; unscoped message insertion retains its side-effect boundary.
- `test/zaq/channels/api_test.exs`: provider-only status selection loads one
  connector and derives connection details from that same row.
- `test/zaq/engine/conversations/token_usage_aggregator_test.exs`: pending coalescing,
  executing-job follow-up, retry-safe totals, explicit date and concurrent-model locks.
- `test/zaq/agent/factory_test.exs` and `factory_tool_timeout_test.exs`: declared
  maximum, default floor, effective worker configuration and live removal.
- `test/zaq/agent/api_test.exs`, `executor_test.exs` and
  `executor_integration_test.exs`: committed malformed-input/binding/runtime/error-
  sanitization/telemetry coverage. Preserve those focused contracts while adding
  real-Jido ownership and race tests rather than counting internal stub coverage
  as proof of B4's external-edges-only flow.
- The committed delivery-confirmation, Engine history-delivery/recovery and
  conversation-identity suites cover failure/retry scopes. Reuse them for B3/.8;
  do not recreate a second confirmation fixture or recovery implementation.
  Concrete paths: `test/zaq/channels/delivery_confirmation_test.exs`,
  `test/zaq/channels/jido_chat_bridge/delivery_result_test.exs`,
  `test/zaq/engine/history/delivery_test.exs`,
  `test/zaq/engine/history_delivery_worker_test.exs` and
  `test/zaq/engine/messages/conversation_identity_test.exs`.

Reuse `Zaq.QueryRecorder` for synchronous domain-query budgets; it records only the
calling process, so it cannot prove the full asynchronous/Jido flow's query count.
Keep those budgets alongside the real full-flow test. Placement work may grow with
recipient count; shared message/connector resolution must not. Budget legitimate
new execution/hydration queries separately rather than weakening existing assertions.

Use explicit endpoint barriers, events, monitored shutdown and sandbox ownership.
Do not accept arbitrary `_request` LLM payloads or blanket-stub internal dispatch.
If shared application configuration is unavoidable, isolate that suite and restore
state; prefer existing per-boundary configuration and ephemeral ports.

Action reuse: verification only; exercise the same production APIs. Document fixture
purpose and record commands/results in Beadwork. These ExUnit integration tests are
immediate regression protection; browser feature E2E retains its human gate.

User authorized proceeding on a new branch inside the CURRENT worktree, superseding the earlier isolated-worktree requirement. Branch feature/issue-768-history-b-execution created at a0c8796e21412a4e4334d4bd5ee928d339638c78 in agile-pangolin. Do not create/move to another worktree. Check effective branch-specific DB/build settings and concurrent edits before validation. PR B remains stacked on feature/issue-768-history-a-integration; no commit/push/merge implied.
